pages.text: A $(item)Reactor Core$() floats inside a huge $(l:building/containment_ring)Containment Ring$(), held in place by four $(l:building/stabilizers)Stabilizers$().$(br2)Feed it mass, charge it with RF and ignite it, and it gives back far more power than it takes.

Run it badly and it melts down.$(br2)Every failure has three ways out: a $(good)skillful fix$(), a $(warn)safe but costly fix$(), and a $(danger)timer$() that runs out if you do nothing.$(br2)Read $(l:safety/failures)Failures$() first.
pages.title: The catch
